#Hive cocoon used by protomorphs to replenish the hive's composition
[bold]Instructions for use[/bold]: By dragging a stunned marine onto the cocoon or using the context menu to grab him, a delay will begin after which the target will be placed in the cocoon!
[bold]Conditions[/bold]: As soon as [color=#ff0000]2 marines[/color] are in the cocoon, a [color=#ff0000]25-second[/color] timer starts, after which the marines' bodies will dissolve and the cocoon will spit out a bloodbuster.
